metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Phoenix, Arizona reach at least 110 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need temperature data for Phoenix, AZ from June 15-21, 2017. Best options: - MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST): MOD11A1 or MYD11A1 (Terra/Aqua) - ERA5 air temperature - ECMWF ERA5-Land I'll use MODIS LST as it's most reliable for max temperature detection. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for this question - we want to know if ANY day reached 110°F. MODIS LST already has QA bands to filter bad pixels. 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero: Temperature readings in valid range (e.g., 20-60°C / 68-140°F) - C1: No images in collection for this date/location - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after QA filtering - C3: Result is None/NaN or invalid (e.g., temperature > 60°C or < -50°C which would be unrealistic) - A: Max temperature >= 110°F (43.33°C) - B: Max temperature < 110°F 4. Phoenix coordinates: approximately 33.4484°N, 112.0740°W 5. Need to convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit: (K - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32 6. MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 0.02 scale factor ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const phoenix = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.0740, 33.4484]); const startDate = '2017-06-15'; const endDate = '2017-06-22'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra LST (day time) let lst = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(phoenix) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const imageCount = lst.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data available for this period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get maximum temperature const maxLst = lst.max(); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = maxLst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: phoenix, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get max temperature value const maxTempK = maxLst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: phoenix, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); if (maxTempK === null || maxTempK === undefined) { console.log('Failed to retrieve temperature value.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert: MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 0.02 const maxTempC = (maxTempK * 0.02) - 273.15; const maxTempF = (maxTempC * 9/5) + 32; console.log(`Max LST (raw): ${maxTempK}`); console.log(`Max temp: ${maxTempC.toFixed(2)}°C / ${maxTempF.toFixed(2)}°F`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (maxTempF > 150 || maxTempF < 50) { console.log('Temperature reading out of realistic range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const threshold = 110.0; console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold}°F`); if (maxTempF >= threshold) { console.log(`Yes, temperature reached ${maxTempF.toFixed(2)}°F (>= 110°F)`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`No, max temperature was ${maxTempF.toFixed(2)}°F (< 110°F)`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
